name: Top of the page
desc: The title, the save status and the buttons in the top bar.

name: Puzzle list, import and export
desc: The puzzle list at the top of the Puzzle Grid panel, its buttons, the Fast import box, the import report and the messages an import or export can show.

name: Grid size, tools and key
desc: Width and height, the clear buttons, the grid itself and the key of what each key draws.

name: Shape editor, Shape Bank and Omits
desc: The side panel next to the grid.

name: Rules

name: Solver
desc: The Solver panel: buttons, options, progress and the result after a solve.

name: Step-by-step reasoning
desc: The step-by-step view: step titles, explanations and captions.

name: Why something is impossible
desc: Short reasons the solver gives. They show in the solver result ("Impossible: …") and inside step-by-step explanations ("this breaks: …").

name: Rule explanations (bottom of the page)
desc: The "Rules with improved deduction logic" list and what each i button opens.

name: Custom rules button
desc: The button at the very bottom of the page.

name: Other messages
desc: Messages that are not tied to one place on the page.
